hypothesis: An isolated implausible ball location can produce strong team evidence even when speed is discarded; a two-sided physical consistency guard should suppress this unsupported evidence.
change: Use the incumbent 45 m/s plausibility bound to reject isolated position spikes, only in an explicit reliable profile; no other parameter change.
primary_metric: unweighted mean of official spell_f1_mean across independent matches

promotion_policy.interpretation: Conservative project criteria, not official rules or a significance guarantee; report paired uncertainty and individual matches.

initial_pilot.selection_basis: Lexicographic source match identifiers before evaluating candidates

stopping_rule: Do not promote from the two-game technical pilot. Stop a candidate after falsified synthetic contract or failed independent criteria; do not use competition public scores for decisions. Final-test data remain locked until candidate selection on independent development matches.
